title: Main building
text:
Main building is the home to various academic and administrative units of IIT Kharagpur including offices of Director and other Deans.

 List of administrative units in main building 

* CDC office
* Purchase section
* UG section
* GATE-JAM office
* Deans' office
* Accounts section

 List of departments in Main building 

* Chemistry
* Electrical Engineering
* Geology & Geophysics
* Humanities & Social Sciences
* Mathematics
* Physics

 List of classrooms 

* Bhatnagar auditorium also known as F116
* Maggu Room also known as F127
* Raman auditorium also known as F142
* S. N. Bose auditorium also known as F134
* S 301
* S 302
